description: Pick up the stone head with the Power Bracelets.

description: This cave entrance leads to a hidden grove and clearing

description: Lift or blow up the rock to uncover the entrance hole.

title: Bomb Island Cave
description: Blow up the rock to reveal the hole in the ground.

title: Bird's Peak Rock Treasure Chamber
description: Hit the nearby Crystal Switches by flying a seagull to them.

title: Dragon Roost Island Battle Cave
description: Bomb the large rock on the beach near the temple ruin where you got the first Wind Waker song before. Defeat all the enemies in all the rooms to light the torches above the doorways. Complete them all to get a Purple Rupee.

title: Enemy Platform
description: Contents: Bokoblins and Kargorocs. Reward: Purple Rupee

title: Enemy Platform x3
description: Use the Deku Leaf to float from the center platforms to the lower ones. Utilize the whirwinds to ascend.

title: Enemy Platform x2
description: Cannons x4, Bokoblins x4, Treasure Chests x2

title: Great Fairy
description: * Upgrade: Double Magic Meter * Requirement: Boomerang or Bombs Look for the swarm of seagulls in the D-7 Two-Eye Reef quadrant and shoot the Octo's eyes to free this fairy. She will double your magic meter.

title: Queen of Fairies
description: * Upgrade: Fire and Ice Arrows Upgrade * Requirement: Ballad of Gales; Forsaken Fortress Second Visit

title: Forest Haven
description: Forest Haven is an island enclosed in a hollowed-out tree trunk. It is home to the great Deku Tree and the Koroks, as well as magical spring water.

title: Forsaken Fortress
description: Tetra's ship's cannon shoots Link over to the Forsaken Fortress to rescue Aryll.

title: Ice Ring Isle
description: Ice Ring Isle is a mini dungeon surrounded by an icy aura. To enter, Link has to shoot a Fire Arrow at the center rock head, then navigate across an icy path to the mouth of the structure. After recovering the Iron Boots, Link can use them to access a lower floor and defeat the enemies there for an Orange Rupee.

title: Rock Spire Isle
description: Rock Spire Isle itself is a series of spires, with boulders on top, that you need to blow up one by one, then leap across.

title: Windfall Island
description: Windfall Island is the central town and store hub. Reminiscent of Kakariko Village, it's recognizable even from far away by its iconic windmill.

title: Withered Tree
description: Part of the [Korok Tree Spirit Quest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=456830) Access through cave

title: Empty Bottle #1
description: Medli will give you this bottle after you help her fly to the entrance of the Dragon Roost Cavern.

title: Empty Bottle #2
description: Enter the submarine near Bomb Isle and defeat all the Bokoblin enemies inside.

title: Empty Bottle #3
description: Buy the bottle for 500 Rupees in Beedle's Special Shop Ship near Rock Spire Isle.

title: Empty Bottle #4
description: Complete the Follow the Thief mini-quest on Windfall Island. It must be night time. Confront Mila about her planned theft and answer all questions with the default answer to get the last Bottle.

title: Tingle Bottle
description: The Tingle Bottle is an item added to The Legend of Zelda: Wind Waker HD for the Wii U. You get it from Tingle when you free him from the jail on Windfall Island. This item unlocks the option to write a message and throw it into the ocean. This is how you use Wind Waker's Miiverse feature. You can also find a Tingle Bottle lying on the shore containing a Miiverse post.

title: Piece of Heart 5
description: Location: Spectacle Island Cannon Minigame Play the Cannon Minigame and destroy all targets (using 10 shots or fewer).

title: Piece of Heart 1
description: Location: Found in a cell below the treasure chest with the dungeon map. The switch to open the cell door is hidden behind the barrels.

title: Piece of Heart 10
description: Location: Small island near the Windfall Island docks After activating the lighthouse, open the treasure chest on the small island near the docks. Use the Hookshot or Deku Leaf to get on top.

title: Piece of Heart 11
description: Location: Maggie's Letter Quest - Windfall Island Auction House, Cafe Bar Receive the letter from [Maggie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450252) after she returns to Windfall as a rich person. Deliver her letter to the [Mailbox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448984). Find Ilari, the Rito Postman, inside the Auction House. Then talk to him in the Cafe Bar. Give Moe's Letter to Maggie.

title: Piece of Heart 12
description: Location: Outset Island Cafe Bar (End of Quest) Complete the Picto Box quest to make [Anton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448991) and [Linda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448997) fall in love. Take a picture of Linda and show it to Anton. Go to the Cafe Bar the next day to get the Piece of Heart from them.

title: Piece of Heart 13
description: Location: Zunari's Trading Quest - complete the quest for [Magic Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447306) to get the Exotic Flower.' * Travel to Bomb Isle to trade for a Sickle Moon Flag. * Back to Greatfish Isle to trade the flagpole for a Fountain Idol. * Mother & Child Isles (remember to sail -- you cannot warp to Child Isle) for a Big Sale Flag. * Go to Bomb Isle. Get the Hero's Flag for 75 Rupees. * Greatfish Isle. You get a Postman Statue for 100 Rupees. * Mother & Child Isles. A 200 Rupees gets you the Shop Guru Statue. * Greatfish Isle. Show the golden statue to the Goron.

title: Piece of Heart 14
description: Location: Windfall Island Items to decorate Windfall Island can be obtained as part of Zunari's Trading Quest. These items can all be used to beautify the town. Just place an item in all of the 14 open sockets around the island. Talk to Sam, the man sitting on the bench, to get a Piece of Heart.

title: Piece of Heart 15
description: Location: Inside the dome on Pawprint Isle Crawl into the shell-like dome and open the treasure chest.

title: Piece of Heart 16
description: Location: Inside sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 30](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454704) to find the sunken chest.

title: Piece of Heart 19
description: Location: Flight Control Platform Gliding Challenge Get the expanded magic meter by defeating the Big Octo at Two-Eye Reef, then float to the goal in the Deku gliding challenge.

title: Piece of Heart 20
description: Location: Beedle's Special Shop Boat Buy the Heart Piece from Beedle's Special Shop Boat for 950 Rupees.

title: Piece of Heart 21
description: Location: In the ocean, near Rock Spire Isle. Sink the two golden gunboats and use the Grappling Hook to retrieve the sunken chests where the boats sank. One will contain the heart.

title: Piece of Heart 22
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454587) to find the sunken chest location.

title: Piece of Heart 23
description: Location: In the ocean near of Tingle Island Look for the seagulls above the water and find and defeat the Big Octo in this sector.

title: Piece of Heart 24
description: Location: Inside sunken chest, marked on [Treasure Chart 38](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454710) Contents: Piece of Heart

title: Piece of Heart 25
description: Location: In the small opening in the rock at Greatfish Isle Change the wind direction to the northwest, then float to the small opening in the rock wall (start from the rock with the Korok tree spirit).

title: Piece of Heart 26
description: Location: Inside the Submarine Enter the submarine and defeat all the Moblins.

title: Piece of Heart 27
description: Location: Inside sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454591) to track down the sunken chest.

title: Piece of Heart 28
description: Location: Inside the fiery treasure chest on the dirt patch. Activate the crystal switch on top of the spire to lower the flames. Contents: Piece of Heart health upgrade

title: Piece of Heart 29
description: Location: Inside a Treasure Chest on the lookout platform Destroy all the cannons on the lookout platform to make the chest appear.

title: Piece of Heart 31
description: Location: Inside Bomb Island Cave Blow up the large rock, enter the cave, and use the Magtails to activate the switches.

title: Piece of Heart 30
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest southwest of the isle Use [Treasure Chart 20](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454603) to find the sunken chest.

title: Piece of Heart 32
description: Location: Use [Treasure Chart 23](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454619) to find the sunken chest Contents: Piece of Heart health upgrade _Note: the location of this chest is slightly different for each playthrough._

title: Piece of Heart 33
description: Location: Inside sunken Treasure Chest southeast of the island Use [Treasure Chart 4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447360) to find the sunken chest.

title: Piece of Heart 35
description: Location: Depends on where you complete the Forest Haven Korok Tree Quest Go to Forest Haven and scoop up some forest spring water with your Bottle. The contents of one bottle can heal (multiple) withering plants, but its healing powers only last 20 minutes (30 minutes in Wind Waker HD) Travel to these islands: * A-5: Needle Rock Isle * B-1: Star Island * B-2: Mother & Child Isles * B-4: Greatfish Isle * C-6: Shark Island * E-3: Eastern Fairy Island * E-5: Link's Oasis * G-6: Cliff Plateau Isles

title: Piece of Heart 34
description: Location: Inside the nearest Mailbox after completing the Forbidden Woods Check the mailbox after you've come back from the Forbidden Woods. Komali's father's letter will have a heart attached.

title: Piece of Heart 36
description: Location: In sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 31](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447351) to locate the chest.

title: Piece of Heart 39 - HD Version
description: Location: Inside the sunken Treasure Chest - HD Version Only Note: Find the location with the help of [Treasure Chart 46](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454729). This location only applies to the Wii U/HD edition of the game. Note for the Wii U Version: use Treasure Chart 46 to find the sunken chest (replaces Triforce Shard location).

title: Piece of Heart 40
description: Location: On top of the Headstone Island spire Stand on the beach and put a Hyoi Pear on your head to call a seagull. Fly to the very top of the rock spire in the center.

title: Piece of Heart 42
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest south of the smaller island. Use [Treasure Chart 15](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454598) to find and raise this sunken chest.

title: Piece of Heart 3
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 11](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454596) to track down the sunken chest.

title: Piece of Heart 43
description: Location: Inside the Submarine near the Five Star Isles Find and enter the submarine and defeat the Bokoblins and Keese bats inside. Climb up the ladder and a torch will light up, revealing a treasure chest.

title: Piece of Heart 41
description: Location: On top of the larger Angular Isle. Push the blocks and find the chest at the top of the isle.

title: Piece of Heart 44
description: Location: In a sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 33](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447352) to track down the location.

title: Piece of Heart 4
description: Location: Defeat Big Octo near Seven-Star Isles Look for the flock of seagulls above the water. Follow them to make Big Octo appear, then use your Boomerang or cannon to shoot out the creature's eyes. After you defeat it, use the Grappling Hook on the area where it sank.

title: Piece of Heart 6
description: Location: Battlesquid in Salvatore's House Talk to Salvatore to play Battesquid. Win the Battlesquid Game by sinking all three squids.

title: Piece of Heart 7
description: Location: Start the Cabana Quest in the School Find all four Killer Bees kids and complete the [Killer Bees Hide-and-Seek](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450268) quest.

title: Piece of Heart 8
description: Location: Hall of Wealth Auction House Participate in the nightly auctions in the rich man's house. A Piece of Heart will appear as a prize after you've won a few auctions.

title: Piece of Heart 9
description: Location: Windmill on Windfall Island Activate the lighthouse windmill by changing the wind direction to north, stepping on the switch at the top of the ladder (in the rear), and shooting an arrow at the central torch. Talk to the man with the hat on the wooden windmill walkway (exit through the door on the second floor from the Battlesquid house).

title: Piece of Heart 2
description: Location: Blow up the boulders with bombs to reveal a hidden cave. Defeat all Magtails, Bokoblins, and Moblins.

title: Piece of Heart 17
description: Location: Dragon Roost Mail Center Beat the mail sorting mini-game by scoring 25 to make Baito, the part-time worker arrive in the mail station. Talk to him and beat the 25 again to get the [Note to Mother](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=458355). Drop it into a mailbox, then wait for a reply containing the heart.

title: Piece of Heart 18
description: Location: Hoskit, inside the Mail Station on Dragon Roost Island Give 20 Golden Feathers to Hoskit, the Rito Guard and he will give Link an Orange Rupee and later send this Piece of Heart by mail.

title: Piece of Heart 37
description: Location: Outset Island Mudpit Once you have the Power Bracelets, return to the island and carry the [Black Pig](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448967) to the muddy spot across the bridge. Use bait and it will dig up the heart.

title: Piece of Heart 38
description: Location: Orca's Hut on Outset Island Compete against Orca in his sword challenge and hit him 500 times.

title: Piece of Heart 39 - GameCube Version
description: Location: Savage Labyrinth on Outset Island Battle your way through the Savage Labyrinth and reach the 50th floor. (GameCube Version only)

title: Wandering Merchant
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Find this Goron Trader on Greatfish Isle, as well as on Bomb Island, and Child Isle. Only one picture is needed for the triple figurine. This Goron Trader figures in Zunari's Trade Quest. Receive a Piece of Heart from him for completing the quest.

title: Aryll
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Aryll, Link's sister figures prominently in the overall main quest. She is also available as a Nintendo Gallery Figurine -- but only by snapping a picture of Link's Grandmother.

title: Sturgeon
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Talk to the old man by targeting him. You can visit him on the second floor by climbing the ladder to get tutorial tips.

title: Orca
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Old master of the sword. Inside his house in the middle of town (first floor). Train with Orca to receive the Hero's Sword and learn basic attack moves.

title: Abe
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Bearded man in green. Wandering around during the day, in his home at night.

title: Zill
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Snot-nosed kid, wandering about during the day, inside his house at night.

title: Mesa
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Guy in orange, cuts his grass during the day. Find him in his house at night. Mesa teaches Link about cutting grass and can be captured for the Nintendo Gallery.

title: Grandma
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Link's grandmother, found inside Link's home. She not only provides links with equipment and advice, but can also be captured as a Nintendo Gallery Figuring. Take a photo and [Aryll](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448942) will unlock at the same time.

title: Sue-Belle
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No The woman in the pink dress carries a pot on her head during the day. Find her in Sturgeon's house at night. Note that if you smash her pot, you'll have to pay 10 Rupees

title: Beedle
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Floating boat shop owner. Outset Island, Forest Haven, and other locations.

title: Rose
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Rose is the owner of the pigs roaming around the island. She's married to Abe and has two kids, Joel and the snot-nosed Zill. Return the three piglets roaming the island to her to receive 3 x 20 Rupees.

title: Joel
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Joel is Zill's brother, and the older son of Abe and Rose. You can find the little boy with his stick near the stone bridge during the day, in his house at night.

title: Potova & Joanna
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Treated as a pair, Potova & Joanna are the self-proclaimed cute little girls. They're always together, either in the school or by the beach.

title: Dampa
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Dampa tells you about his pet pigs. He is outside the Bomb Shop during the day and inside the Cafe at night.

title: Maggie's Father
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Maggie's Father will ask you to rescue his daughter, Maggie, when you first meet him sitting at the tree at the beginning of game. He later becomes rich and resides on the second floor of the rich man's Mansion.

title: Kane
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Kane, the sailor, will reward Link for decorating the town. He's the big guy, wearing a green and blue shirt. By the town gate during the day and inside the cafe at night. * 50 Rupees: Place Postman Statue on top of the gate * 50 Rupees: Place Shop Guru on top of the gate * 20 Rupees: Place Idols on top of the six pedestals * 20 Rupees: Place flags on top of the six pedestals

title: Candy
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Candy, the sailor, will reprimand Link for asking him for a sail.

title: Anton
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Anton, wearing a striped shirt, will walk around town and is found in many locations

title: Tott
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Tott, the dancer, will teach Link the Song of Passing once he has the Wind Waker.

title: Linda
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Linda is the young woman in orange, near the windmill. She'll be inside the cafe after concluding her photo quest. Take a Pictograph of Linda and show it to Anton to have the two fall in love. Reward: * Piece of Heart

title: Killer Bees
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Four kids, hanging out near the school. Only a photo of one of them is needed for the quadruple figurine. This group of kids is made up of Ivan, Jin, Jun-Roberto, and Jan.

title: Old Man Ho Ho
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Old Man Ho Ho appears in multiple locations and provides hints on surrounding areas.

title: Ankle
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Tingle in pink clothes. Found on top of the Tingle Island tower.

title: David Jr.
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Tingle in white clothes. Found on the Tingle Island tower.

title: Fairy
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Find these tiny fairies inside pots or at any of the Fairy Wells.

title: Lenzo
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Bearded Picto Shop owner, inside his atelier all day and night. Go to the second floor or sneak in through balcony to get a good shot.

title: Fairy Queen
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No The Fairy Queen Pictograph cannot be taken at the Queen's location. You have to buy this Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo during a night with a Waning Crescent moon.

title: Fishman
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215). This talking fish that can be found near every island. Snap a picture from far away when he's jumping out of the water.

title: Tetra
description: * Missable: Yes * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215). Also unlocks the entire Pirate Posse. Snap her picture of Tetra she follows you into Hyrule Castle. If missed, you can get her by starting the Second Quest and take a picture of her on the beach on Outset Island.

title: Senza
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

title: Zuko
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

title: Gonzo
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

title: Mako
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

title: Niko
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

title: Nudge
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

title: Great Fairy
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Available when the moon is in its Waning Gibbous phase).

title: King of Hyrule
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (available when the moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase).

title: Knuckle
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: This statue is not required to complete the Gallery Appears on Tingle Island after solving his GBA Tingle Tuner challenge on Outset Island. Knuckle is missable in the GameCube version. Make sure to take the photo before collecting all Tingle Status (he becomes available after completing the Tingle Tuner event). In the HD version, he will remain on Tingle Island.

title: Link and the King of Red Lions
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: Yes (If previous figurines are missed) Bonus figurine. Awarded once you collect all figurines (except Knuckle).

title: Loot
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Found at the Boating Course island during the day and in the Windfall cafe at night.

title: Princess Zelda
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Bundled with [King of Hyrule](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450223). No photo necessary.

title: Salvage Corp
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Look for this diving crew searching for treasures near several islands. You're likely to encounter them first in this location.

title: Salvatore
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Salvatore is the challenge attraction owner. He is found in the Windfall Island windmill building and on Spectacle Island.

title: Tingle
description: * Set: Hall G: The Great Sea * Missable: No Once rescued from the [Windfall Island Jail](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448995), the green fairy is found on the Tingle Island tower.

title: Cannon
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No The owner of the Bomb Shop is found inside the building at the edge of town.

title: Zunari
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Owner of the local shop.

title: Doc Bandam
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Doc Bandam is the Potion Shop owner. He's inside the Chu Jelly Juice shop at all times.

title: Garrickson
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Dressed in red overalls, Garrickson is the love-stricken mustachioed man wo walks to the mailbox every day.

title: Kamo
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Depressed young man. Sitting on the steps during the day, gazing at the stars on the town wall at night. Has [Treasure Chart 31](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447351).

title: Kreeb
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Man with yellow hat, on the wooden windmill walkway (exit the second floor above Salvatore's Battlesquid challenge).

title: Maggie
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Rich little girl (once poor), on the second floor of the rich man's house (above the auction)

title: Mila
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No This poor little girl (once rich, before her fortune's were reversed), is found near the gate and Juice Shop, and later near Zunari's stand.

title: Mila's Father
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Rich man, first encountered in his house on the second floor. He later becomes poor and stands by the tree near the Bomb Shop where it's easy to take his picture.

title: Minenco
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Minenco is th older lady in orange, by the Juice Shop.

title: Missy
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Dampe's mother is found on the docks down the steps from the Juice Shop. You can easily take her photo from your boat.

title: Miss Marie
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Miss Marie is the pink-haired teacher, inside the school at all times.

title: Pompie & Vera
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Treated as a pair, Pompie & Vera are the two gossiping ladies near Zunari's shop. Double figurine. The two also provide [Treasure Chart 24](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447347)

title: Sam
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Sam is the guy with sideburns and brown vest, on the bench to the left of the cafe.

title: Crab
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No The Crab Gallery Figurine can be unlocked by taking a full, head-on photo of the crustacean on the beach. The crab has to facing Link and be fully visible.

title: Jabun
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Fish spirit. Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Available when the moon is in its Last Quarter).

title: Pig
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Depending on when or where you visit, there are small or large pigs wandering around on Outset and Windfall Island. One photo is enough to get the quadruple-figurine of all pig types.

title: Seagull
description: * Set: Hall E: Outset Island * Missable: No Sea bird. Found nearly everywhere.

title: Gillian
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Cafe owner, behind the counter.

title: Gossack
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Old man, easily startled. In the cafe during the day.

title: Gummy
description: * Set: Hall F: Windfall Island * Missable: No Big sailor, wears a yellow shirt and black vest. Appears in the auction house at night. Snap picture after the auction ends.

title: Big Octo
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: Yes This sea monster is found near Seven-Star Isles, Tingle Island, Fire Mountain, Private Oasis, Diamond Steppe Island, Two-Eye Reef. Do not forget to take photos of it before you defeat them all!

title: Blue Wizzrobe
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: No Blue Wizzrobes are found in various locations, including platforms and submarines. A sure-fire encounter for purposes of picture taking can be triggered by going into the Savage Labyrinth.

title: Darknut
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: No Darknuts are armored knights found in various locations, such as dungeons and caves. A guaranteed encounter occurs in the Tower of the Gods.

title: Darknut (2)
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: No This second golden variant of the armored Darknut knight is easily found inside Hyrule Castle.

title: Mighty Darknut
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: Yes There are two chances to get a snapshot of this Darknut Captain in red armor: once in the battle in the castle basement, and again on the stairwell leading up to the fight with Ganon.

title: Gohdan, the Great Arbiter
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: No Statue head and hands, boss inside Tower of the Gods. You can snap a photo later when Gohdan has turned back into an immobile statue.

title: Red Wizzrobe
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: Yes This bird magician is clad in red and wears head gear. Catch it during the mini-boss battle in the Wind Temple.

title: Moblin
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses and Mini-Bosses * Missable: No Pig warrior, in various dungeons and caves, such as the Forsaken Fortress.

title: Phantom Ganon
description: * Set: Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss * Missable: Yes Shadow warrior, in the Forsaken Fortress courtyard (second visit) and Ganon's Tower.

title: Stalfos
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Skeleton warrior, inside dungeons and caves, such as the Earth Temple.

title: Bokoblin
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Link meets his first Bokoblin on Outset Island., but this green, blue, or pink goblin creature is commonly found in dungeons, caves, and on rafts and lookout platforms. One photo is enough for the triple-figurine.

title: Floor Master
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Floor Master are creepy hands that are found in various caves and dungeons, including the Earth Temple.

title: Keese & Fire Keese
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No These bats are common and found everywhere -- a single picture of one type gets you the double set.

title: Magtail
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Found in hot areas such as Dragon Roost Cavern and the Savage Labyrinth, you'll easily spot Magtails on Fire Mountain.

title: Red Bubble & Blue Bubble
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No These floating skulls come in two varieties. Take a picture of either one.

title: Rat
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Commonly found inside ships and basements, Rats are easily photographed in the Forsaken Fortress.

title: Boko Baba
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Easily spot the people-eating plants inside Forest Haven and the Forbidden Woods. Also found in various caves, from the Savage Labyrinth to the Cliff Plateau Isles.

title: Miniblin
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Miniblins are common on smaller islands and inside dungeons.

title: ChuChu
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No ChuChus are common across many islands. Take a picture of any color to complete the gallery figure.

title: Peahat
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No You'll spot Peahats in the Forbidden Woods, Forest Haven, Outset Island the Wind Temple, and more.

title: Gyorg
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Gyorg are common shark-like enemies found everywhere in the ocean. Spot their fin in the water and snap a picture even if the entire creature isn't exposed.

title: Octorok
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Octoroks are found in the sea and rivers around Forest Haven, Forbidden Woods, Six-Eyed Reef, Shark Island, Boating Course, Forsaken Fortress, the Triangle Islands, and more.

title: Seahat
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Common ocean enemy, found around islands in large groups. Horsehoe Island has a large number of them.

title: Kargaroc
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No These birds, also known as Kargarok (with a k) in other Zelda games, can be spotted around many rocky islands, including Dragon Roost Island.

title: Armos
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No These living statues are common inside the Tower of the Goods, as well as on Stone Watcher Island, in the Wind Temple, and the Savage Labyrinth.

title: Armos Knight
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No The upgraded version of the Armos is found in the Tower of the Goods, the Wind Temple, and the Savage Labyrinth.

title: Morth
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Easily found inside the Forbidden Woods, Morth are spawned by Mothulas and Yellow Wizrobes, and appear in grass and barrels.

title: Poe
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No Poe are lantern-carrying ghosts you can photograph in the Earth Temple, the Ghost Ship, Ganon's Castle, and in the Savage Labyrinth.

title: ReDead
description: * Set: Hall C: Enemies * Missable: No The screaming undead are found in the Earth Temple, Private Oasis, Ganon's Castle, and the Savage Labyrinth.

title: Baito
description: * Set: Hall B: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No Human part-time employee. Arrives on Dragon Roost Island after you score 25 letters in the sorting mini-game or after defeating the boss.

title: Basht & Bisht
description: * Set: Hall B: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: Mo These two honest and sincere Rito guards are found inside the main hall guarding exits with their spears.

title: The Rito Chieftain
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No The leader of the Rito, the Rito Chieftain, can be found inside his chambers. He wears a red robe.

title: Hoskit
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No Hoskit the Rito waits outside the Chieftain's room and asks you for Golden Feathers. He'll reward Link with an Orange Rupee and a Piece of Heart for 20 of them.

title: Ilari
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No The Rito postman can be seen on top of the outdoor platform. Take the picture before going to the Earth Temple. He is later seen on Outset Island.

title: Koboli
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No This tall Rito stands behind the mail counter inside Dragon Roost Mountain.

title: Namali
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No Rito bookkeeper, walks around the mail station with a clipboard.

title: Medli
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No Young Rito girl and one of the two sages. Encountered on Dragon Roost Island, she will stay in the boss room of the Earth Temple after the boss battle.

title: Pashli
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No Pashli is the second Rito carrying a clipboard -- unlike Namali, he hurries about and his feather-doo is spiked up.

title: Obli
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No Goggle-wearing Rito, complete with Orville Wright mustache. On the Flight Control Platform. Take the picture right before you take the challenge.

title: Komali
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern * Missable: No Prince Komali is first encountered inside his room. After finishing the Earth Temple, he's on this cliff location here.

title: Quill
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No Mailman you first met on Outset. Bundled with Chieftain figurine.

title: Skett & Akoot
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No The Chieftain's guards guarding the exit from this room. Two-in one statue.

title: Valoo
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No Valoo is the giant dragon on top of Dragon Roost Mountain. You only need a headshot -- can be taken from far away.

title: Willi
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No The Wilbur to Obli's Orville. On the Flight Control Platform, standing in front of the ladder.

title: Zephos & Cyclos
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: Yes Wind gods. Take a picture of Cyclos when you get caught in his tornado, eg: near Shark Island. If you shoot him with an arrow before you've taken the photo, you're out of luck and have to wait till the second quest.

title: Laruto
description: * Set: Hall C: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No Zora. Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (First Quarter).

title: The Monstrous Helmaroc King
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses and Mini-Bosses * Missable: Yes The Helmaroc King is first seen on Outset Island, but can't be photographed there. The only chance to capture a picture is when returning to the Forsaken Fortress, during the boss battle.

title: Makar
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No The Korok playing the violin also acts as sage and is first encountered behind the waterfall on Forest Haven. He will stay in the Wind Temple's boss room after you finish it.

title: Deku Tree
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No The Great Deku Tree is found at the center of Forest Haven.

title: Fado
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No Young Kokiri. Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Waxing Crescent).

title: Olivio
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No The Korok with the red leaf permanently settles on Eastern Fairy Island and can be found as part of the Withered Tree quest.

title: Hollo
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No Hollo is the Korok potion master, found on the ground floor of Forest Haven, through the exit with the sign next to it.

title: Elma
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No Korok with round leaf. First seen inside Forest Haven, later settles on Needle Rock Island.

title: Drona
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No The green Korok with the forked leaf is first spotted inside Forest Haven, but later permanently settles on the Private Oasis.

title: Rown
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No First seen in Forest Haven, this brown Korok with the five-fingered leaf later settles on the Mother & Child Isles.

title: Irch
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No This brown Korok with large oval birch leaf is first spotted in Forest Haven before permanently settling on Shark Island.

title: Oakin
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No This tall Korok is first spotted in Forest Haven, before settling on Star Island.

title: Aldo
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No Green Korok with heart-shaped alder leaf is spotted inside Forest Haven before moving to the Cliff Plateau Isles. To reach him, you'll have to head through the cave.

title: Linder
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No Green Korok with butterfly-shaped leaf, settles on Greatfish Isle.

title: Carlov the Sculptor
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No The owner of the figurine gallery. Behind the counter.

title: Manny
description: * Set: Hall A: Forest Haven * Missable: No Inside the gallery. Either standing near counter or looking at figurines in the rooms.

title: Kogoli
description: * Set: Hall B: Dragon Roost Island * Missable: No Rito delivery man, outside on the launch platform. Take the picture before going to the Earth Temple.

title: Mothula
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: No Spot the flying creature for the first time as a mini-boss inside the Forbidden Woods. You can also find Mothulas on Dragon Roost Island, Horsehoe Island, Outset Island's Savage Labyrinth.

title: Ganondorf
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: No Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Full Moon)

title: Jalhalla, Protector of the Seal
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: No Lantern ghost, boss inside Earth Temple and Ganon's Tower.

title: Puppet Ganon
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: Yes You only have one chance to take a picture of this marionette boss inside Ganon's Tower.

title: Molgera, Protector of the Seal
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: No Sand shark, boss inside Wind Temple and Ganon's Tower.

title: Kalle Demos
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: No Plant monster, boss inside Forbidden Woods and Ganon's Tower.

title: Gohma
description: * Set: Hall D: Bosses * Missable: No Gohma is an arachnid boss who lives in a lava lake. To make it vulnerable to your sword attacks, use your Grappling Hook to connect to the hook under the ceiling, above its head. and Ganon's Tower. You can take its picture during the Dragon Roost Cavern Boss Batlte or in Ganon's Twoer.

title: Song of Passing
description: Directions: Right, Left, Down Effect: Turn day to night and night to day. Learn the Song of Passing from Tott by taking out the Wind Waker.

title: Ballad of Gales
description: Directions: Down, Right, Left, Up Effect: Warp around the map. Head for the tornado and get sucked in -- then use your bow to shoot Cyclos three times to receive the Ballad of Gales song. Play the Ballad of Gales to warp between map locations.

title: Wind God's Aria
description: Directions: Up, Up, Down, Right, Left, Right Effect: Play in a duo with Makar to open stone seals Put on your Iron Boots to get past the strong wind and approach the cave entrance. Equip your hammer and smash the giant stone head that generates the wind. Enter the cave and walk up to the stone seal. Examine it with A, then take out your Wind Waker and play the melody: up, up, down, right, left, right.

title: Wind's Requiem
description: Directions: Up, Left, Right Effect: Change the direction of the wind. Get out the Wind Waker and play the melody you see engraved on the stone tablet: Up, Left, Right. You will meet Zephos and learn the Wind's Requiem.

title: Command Melody
description: Directions: Left, Center, Right, Center Effect: Control a friendly character or idol to solve puzzles Find the door with the magenta Triforce symbol. If you bring an idol into this room, the stone tablet revealing the song will appear.

title: Earth God's Lyric
description: Directions: Down, Down, Center, Right, Left, Center Effect: Play in a duo with Medli to open stone seals Lift up that giant stone head with the help of the Power Bracelets and smash it on the ground. Enter the cave.

title: Beedle's Chart
description: * Location: Get by Mail * Use: Marks the locations of Beedle's Shop Ships To get Beedle's Chart, progress through the story and get the Bombs in Windfall Island. As soon as you've got the Bombs, Beedle will send you a letter in the mail with this chart attached.

title: Ghost Ship Chart
description: Location: Inside the cave * Use: Tells you the location of the [Ghost Ship](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449303), based on the phase of the moon Once you get the Hookshot, enter the cave on top of this ship-shaped rock and follow the map instructions above.

title: Great Fairy Chart (via Chart 41)
description: Location: Inside Chest, marked on [Treasure Chart 41](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447358) Contents: Great Fairy Chart _The Great Fairy Chart marks the locations of all the Fairy Fountains._

title: In-Credible Chart
description: * Location: Any Mailbox * Use: The IN-Credible Chart lists all the Triforce Chart locations, and, once you've had a Triforce Chart deciphered by Tingle, also the corresponding Triforce location. Rescue your sister from the Forsaken Fortress. After those events, find any Mailbox to get this key chart from Tingle. It costs 201 Rupees.

title: Island Hearts Chart
description: * Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest near the platform * Use: Marks all Pieces of Hearts located on islands. Use [Treasure Chart 19](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447345) to track down the location.

title: Light Ring Chart
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest on the east wall of Cyclops Reef Use [Treasure Chart 21](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447359) to track down the location.

title: Octo Chart
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest * Use: This chart lists the locations of all the Big Octos. Track the location via [Treasure Chart 26](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454627).

title: Platform Chart
description: * Location: Inside the submarine * Use: Marks all lookout platforms Defeat all enemies inside the submarine.

title: Sea Hearts Chart
description: Location: Inside a sunken Treasure Chest Use [Treasure Chart 32](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449172) to locate it.

title: Secrets Chart
description: Location: Inside sunken chest south of Overlook Island Use [Treasure Chart 13](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447343) to track down the location.

title: Submarine Chart
description: * Location: Boating Course Small Island * Requirement: Boomerang * Use: Marks all submarines Float over to the small island near the Boating Course start location, enter the Boating Course Cave, and activate the switches to get the Submarine Chart.

title: Tingle's Map
description: Location: Get from Tingle in Windfall Island Jail Use: Marks the location of Tingle and Rupee-Focused Fairy Wells Release Tingle from his cell on Windfall Island. Known as Tingle's Chart in the GameCube version.

title: Triforce Chart 6 (GameCube)
description: Reach Floor 30 of the Savage Labyrinth to get Triforce Chart 6 in the GameCube version only. Follow it to [Triforce Shard 6 (GameCube)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447319).

title: Treasure Chart 14
description: Location: Submarine near Headstone Island Leads to: E-4: Tower of the Gods ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449642)) Defeat all enemies in the submarine

title: Treasure Chart 13
description: Location: Two-Eye Reef Leads to: G-1: Overlook Island [Secrets Chart](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447232) Destroy the wall-mounted cannons, then float to the chest.

title: Treasure Chart 16
description: Location: On the three lookout platforms near Seven-Star Isles Leads to: C-6: Shark Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449646)) Defeat all Wizzrobes on the nearby platforms (two additional ones after the first two).

title: Treasure Chart 19
description: Location: Inside chest that appears after defeating all cannons Leads to: G-2: Flight Control Platform ([Island Hearts Chart](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447227)) Destroy all cannons and float to the chest.

title: Treasure Chart 22
description: Location: Inside submarine Leads to: C-2: Spectacle Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449660)) Clear the rope challenge inside the submarine.

title: Treasure Chart 24
description: Location: Windfall Island Leads to: ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447585)) Take and show a picture of Lenzoand Minenco together to the gossiping women, Pompie and Vera.

title: Treasure Chart 27
description: Location: On top of the waterfall next to the Cabana Leads to: G-3: Star Belt Archipelago ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449572))

title: Treasure Chart 29
description: Location: Lenzo's Photo Lab 2F on Windfall Island Leads to: Windfall Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449564)) Use the Deku Leaf to float to the second floor of Lenzo's photo lab.

title: Treasure Chart 31
description: Location: Windfall Island, take Moon Pictograph Leads to: F-6: Forest Haven Take a color photo of the moon and show it to the young man, [Kamo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450249), sitting on the steps.

title: Treasure Chart 33
description: Location: Windfall Island, Minenco Photo Quest Leads to: G-7: Five Star Isles ([Piece of Heart 44](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447442)) Take a color photo of the lady in orange, Minenco, and show it to her.

title: Treasure Chart 34
description: Location: Salvage Corp. at Eastern Triangle Island or other islands Leads to: F-4: Eastern Triangle Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447582)) Talk to the salvage crew here -- or anywhere else on the map.

title: Treasure Chart 36
description: Location: Ice Ring Isle perimeter Leads to: G-5: Bird's Peak Rock ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449575)) Melt the ice on the chest outside with a Fire Arrow.

title: Treasure Chart 37
description: Location: Inside the Rock Spire Isle Cave Leads to: F-3: Fire Mountain ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449578)) Blow up the boulders and enter the cave. Light the torches.

title: Treasure Chart 39
description: Location: Dragon Roost Cavern 2F Leads to: F-2: Dragon Roost Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447579)) Inside the cavern. Bust the barrier and swing across.

title: Treasure Chart 40
description: Location: Inside a chest on the platform (without a ladder) near Southern Fairy Island Leads to: C-7: Headstone Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449604)) Destroy the cannons on two of the three platforms (this one and the one to its west) to make the treasure chest appear. Change the wind direction and float over from the adjacent platform to get to the chest.

title: Treasure Chart 41
description: Location: Inside Treasure Chest on the center pillar of Five-Eye Reef (after destroying the cannons) Leads to: A-2: Four-Eye Reef [Great Fairy Chart (via Chart 41)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447225) Blow up the wall-mounted cannons and float to the chest.

title: Treasure Chart 21
description: Location: Cyclops Reef Leads to: C-4: Cyclops Reef ([Light Ring Chart](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447228)) Destroy the cannons and float across.

title: Treasure Chart 4
description: Location: Beedle's Special Shop Ship near Rock Spire Isle Leads to: D-6: Southern Fairy Island ([Piece of Heart 33](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447432)) Buy the chart from Beedle for 900 Rupees.

title: Treasure Chart 6
description: Location: Tower of the Gods, 1F Leads to: D-5: Six-Eye Reef ([(Silver Rupee)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449560)) Shoot the eye switch with the Blow and Arrow in the 1F west chamber.

title: Treasure Chart 32
description: Location: Inside chest on top of the reef. Leads to: F-7: Boating Course ([Sea Hearts Chart](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447231)) Defeat all cannons on the inside of the reef to make it appear.

title: Treasure Chart 28
description: Location: Inside a treasure chest that appears after completing the island challenge Leads to: Needle Rock Isle ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449194)) Complete the "mini-golf" challenge by using the Deku Leaf to roll the seeds into the holes in the course.

title: Treasure Chart 8
description: Location: Inside a chest inside the Horsehoe Island Cave. Leads to: A-3: Western Fairy Island ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449165)) Defeat the enemies inside the hole.

title: Treasure Chart 17
description: Location: Spectacle Island Cannon Game Leads to: E-6: Ice Ring Isle ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449648)) Beat the Cannon Minigame by destroying all targets a second time.

title: Treasure Chart 1
description: Location: Inside a Treasure Chest inside the Forbidden Woods, 3F Leads to: Private Oasis ([Rupee Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447572)) Use the flower bud to float across to the southwest balcony. Use your Boomerang on the vine and open the treasure chest.

title: Treasure Chart 2
description: Location: Inside the Auction House on Windfall Island Leads to: B-3: Rock Spire Isle ([Piece of Heart 22](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447420)) Give Maggie's Father 20 Skull Necklaces after he becomes a rich man and appears in the Auction House.

title: Treasure Chart 3
description: Location: Inside a Treasure Chest on a small island southeast of Forest Haven Leads to: E-3: Eastern Fairy Island ([Silver Rupee)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449559)) Climb up to the ledge that leads to the Forbidden Woods inside Forest Haven (it's the plateau with the arrow). Change the direction of the wind to southwest then hover to it using your Deku Leaf.

title: Treasure Chart 35
description: Location: Gale Isle B1 Leads to: B-5: Islet of Steel ([Silver Rupee](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449574)) Break floor panels and defeat all enemies in B1 room.

title: Treasure Chart 5
description: Location: On floor B1 of the Wind Temple Leads to: G-4: Thorned Fairy Island ([Piece of Heart 27](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447426)) Defeat all enemies (look in the pots) in the round B1 arena.

title: Treasure Chart 7
description: Location: Salvatore's House, Battlesquid Game Leads to: B-1: Star Island ([Silver Rupee)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449561)) Sink all the squids in the Battlesquid mini-game.

title: Treasure Chart 9

title: Seahat
description: Seahats are water-based cousins of the much smaller, flying Peahats. Seahats are easily spotted because of their size -- that is, if the helicopter sound hasn't given them away by then. Hit it again to defeat it and always reveal an item orb. You can also use a single cannon shot to blow it to tomorrow.
